data.name: TT_Lapras_001
data.value: The sea is calm today.[pause=20] Heading back, or staying a while longer?

data.name: TT_Lapras_002
data.value: Return to the mainland?

data.name: TT_Kangaskhan_001
data.value: Your things are safe with me.[pause=20] Leave what weighs you down,[pause=10] the road is long.

data.name: TT_Kecleon_001
data.value: Welcome to the market![pause=15] Everything you need to set out again,[pause=10] and nothing that breaks on the way.

data.name: TT_KecleonP_001
data.value: My brother sells the essentials.[pause=20] I sell what you only find once.[pause=15] Take your time.

data.name: TT_Duskull_001
data.value: Your savings sleep soundly here.[pause=20] I never sleep,[pause=10] and I never lose a thing.

data.name: TT_Electivire_001
data.value: Looking to learn a move?[pause=20] I've got what you need.[pause=15] For a price, of course.

data.name: TT_Xatu_001
data.value: ...[pause=25] You've come from far away.[pause=20] The wind that follows you isn't from here.

data.name: TT_Vigoroth_001
data.value: Unload, carry, repeat![pause=15] That's port life for you.

data.name: TT_Shuppet_001
data.value: They say a whole town was built on a beach.[pause=20] Us.[pause=15] We're that town.

data.name: TT_Murkrow_001
data.value: Explorers arriving by sea...[pause=20] Been a while.

data.name: TT_Pidgey_001
data.value: You crossed over?[pause=15] On someone's back?[pause=20] I fly. Simpler.

data.name: TT_Corphish_001
data.value: Hey hey![pause=15] Water's fine today!

data.name: TT_Marill_001
data.value: We hunt for treasure on the beach, me and my little brother![pause=20] Well...[pause=10] mostly shells.

data.name: TT_Azurill_001
data.value: Big brother says not to go far from the edge.[pause=20] So I stay here!

data.name: TT_Bidoof_001
data.value: Yup![pause=15] Finest town on the coast, by golly.[pause=20] Well,[pause=10] it's the only one I know.

data.name: TT_Figurant_001
data.value: Busy today.[pause=20] Makes a change.

data.name: TT_Sign_Kecleon
data.value: "Kecleon Market.[pause=15] Exploration goods, honest prices."

data.name: TT_Sign_Kangaskhan
data.value: "Kangaskhan Storage.[pause=15] Your goods kept safe, whatever happens."

data.name: TT_Sign_Electivire
data.value: "Move tutoring.[pause=15] Hit hard, hit true."

data.name: TT_Sign_CrossRoads
data.value: "To the crossroads.[pause=15] Guild atop the cliff."
